jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Greater China)
jobs.description:
Xendit provides payment infrastructure across Southeast Asia and is expanding to Greater China and LATAM. We process payments, power marketplaces, disburse payroll and loans, provide KYC solutions, prevent fraud, and help businesses grow exponentially. We serve our customers by providing a suite of world-class APIs, eCommerce platform integrations, and easy to use applications for individual entrepreneurs, SMEs, and enterprises alike.

Our main focus is building the most advanced payment rails for Southeast Asia, with a clear goal in mind — to make payments across and within SEA simple, secure and easy for everyone. We serve thousands of businesses ranging from SMEs to multinational enterprises, and process millions of transactions monthly. We’ve been growing rapidly since our inception in 2015, onboarding hundreds of new customers every month, and backed by global top-10 VCs . We’re proud to be featured on among the fastest growing companies by Y-Combinator .

About the Job

At Xendit, we are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to support our Greater China clients and help drive their success on our platform.

In this role, you will own the post-go-live customer lifecycle for a portfolio of Chinese-speaking accounts, working closely with clients to drive adoption, resolve day-to-day issues, and surface opportunities for growth. You will build a solid understanding of your clients' payment flows and business needs, and use that understanding to make practical recommendations that improve their experience.

You will work with both technical and business stakeholders, supporting solutioning discussions and coordinating with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams to resolve client needs.

This role is ideal for someone earlier in their Customer Success career who has a working knowledge of payments and alternative payment methods in Southeast Asia, and is comfortable managing client relationships in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Minimum Qualifications

- 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or related client-facing roles within B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments environments

- Familiarity with payments and alternative payment methods (APMs) across Southeast Asia

- Experience managing client accounts, including supporting adoption, retention, and day-to-day relationship management

- Ability to engage confidently with client stakeholders (managers and product/technical leads)

- Working understanding of technical products (e.g. APIs, integrations, payment flows) and ability to explain product capabilities to clients

- Excellent communication skills in English and Mandarin (business proficiency required) to support Greater China clients

- Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams

- Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive and detail-oriented approach

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure

- Prior experience supporting clients in Greater China (Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong)

- Exposure to multi-market or cross-border client environments

- Familiarity with data analysis or reporting (e.g. transaction success rates)

- Interest in growing into a senior Customer Success or Account Management role

Responsibilities

- Own a portfolio of Chinese-speaking accounts, supporting adoption, retention, and day-to-day account health

- Build an understanding of clients' business models and payment flows to identify improvement opportunities

- Support expansion opportunities (upsell, cross-sell, new use cases) in partnership with Account Management and Sales

- Act as a day-to-day point of contact for client stakeholders on product usage and issue resolution

- Support solutioning discussions for new use cases, working with Product and Engineering teams

- Monitor key performance metrics (e.g. payment success rates, adoption) and flag issues proactively

- Manage and escalate risks and issues to ensure high customer satisfaction

- Coordinate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Commercial teams to resolve client needs

jobs.title: IT GRC Analyst
jobs.description:
Xendit provides payment infrastructure across Southeast Asia and is expanding to Greater China and LATAM. We process payments, power marketplaces, disburse payroll and loans, provide KYC solutions, prevent fraud, and help businesses grow exponentially. We serve our customers by providing a suite of world-class APIs, eCommerce platform integrations, and easy to use applications for individual entrepreneurs, SMEs, and enterprises alike.

Our main focus is building the most advanced payment rails for Southeast Asia, with a clear goal in mind — to make payments across and within SEA simple, secure and easy for everyone. We serve thousands of businesses ranging from SMEs to multinational enterprises, and process millions of transactions monthly. We’ve been growing rapidly since our inception in 2015, onboarding hundreds of new customers every month, and backed by global top-10 VCs . We’re proud to be featured on among the fastest growing companies by Y-Combinator .

About the Job

At Xendit, we are looking for a mid-level/senior-level IT GRC Analyst to sit at the intersection of technology, compliance, and risk — not just for Indonesia, but across all of Xendit's operating markets. As an individual contributor, you will be responsible for ensuring our IT systems, processes, and controls meet the regulatory obligations and certification standards of every jurisdiction we operate in. You will be our regional GRC go-to person, coordinating directly with regulatory bodies across the regions (Bank Indonesia / OJK, BSP, BOT, etc). Beyond regulatory compliance, you will own and drive the full lifecycle of our IT certifications such as PCI-DSS and ISO 27001. You will work closely with engineering, security, product, and legal teams to embed compliance into how we build and operate. This is a role for someone who is detail-oriented, thrives in multi-market complexity, and can translate a wide range of regulatory requirements into practical, actionable controls in a fast-moving fintech environment.

Minimum Qualifications

- 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT GRC, IT Risk Management, or IT Compliance roles

- Solid working knowledge of PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 frameworks, including implementation, certification, and audit readiness

- Familiarity with Bank Indonesia (BI) and OJK IT governance regulations applicable to payment service providers in Indonesia

- Exposure to or willingness to take regulatory requirements in at least one other Southeast Asian or international market (e.g., BSP, BOT, MAS, BNM, or equivalent)

- Proven experience conducting IT risk assessments, control testing, and gap analyses

- Demonstrated ability to develop, review, and maintain IT policies, standards, and procedures

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate diverse regulatory requirements into technical and operational controls

- Effective communicator who can engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience navigating Bank Indonesia's PJP (Penyelenggara Jasa Pembayaran) Category 1 or Category 2 licensing requirements, including ongoing IT compliance obligations and regulatory examination readiness

- Hands-on experience managing end-to-end certification processes — scoping, readiness assessment, evidence preparation, auditor coordination, and post-certification surveillance — for ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or SOC 2

- Direct experience coordinating IT audits or regulatory examinations with regional bodies such as BSP (Philippines), BOT (Thailand), MAS (Singapore), BNM (Malaysia), etc

- Relevant professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor

- Prior experience in fintech, digital payments, or financial services in a multi-market Southeast Asian or global context

- Exposure to cloud environments and understanding of cloud security control frameworks

- Background in working cross-functionally with engineering and product teams to embed compliance-by-design principles

Responsibilities

- Own and support Xendit's compliance programs for certification and regulatory audits, ensuring controls are implemented, tested, and evidenced effectively

- Serve as the primary GRC point of contact for regional regulatory needs, coordinating IT-related audit and examination processes with regional regulatory bodies

- Manage the full certification lifecycle for applicable frameworks — from initial scoping and gap analysis through certification issuance and ongoing surveillance — ensuring timely renewals and continuous compliance

- Conduct periodic IT risk assessments across markets, maintain a consolidated IT risk register, and track remediation activities through to closure

- Perform internal control testing and assessments to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of IT controls across Xendit's regional entities

- Identify compliance gaps across markets and work with relevant teams to develop and execute remediation plans

- Develop, review, update, and enforce IT policies, standards, and procedures in line with multi-jurisdictional regulatory and framework requirements

- Coordinate regulatory and third-party audits end-to-end, including preparing evidence packages, managing auditor requests, and facilitating examiner meetings

- Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape across all operating markets and assess the impact of new or updated requirements on Xendit's IT environment

- Produce compliance dashboards, regional status reports, and management briefings to keep stakeholders informed of GRC posture across all markets

- Collaborate with engineering, product, security, and legal teams to embed compliance and risk considerations into project delivery and system design

- Support continuous improvement of GRC processes, tooling, and automation to scale compliance operations efficiently across a growing number of markets

jobs.title: Treasury Manager
jobs.description:
Xendit provides payment infrastructure across Southeast Asia and is expanding to Greater China and LATAM. We process payments, power marketplaces, disburse payroll and loans, provide KYC solutions, prevent fraud, and help businesses grow exponentially. We serve our customers by providing a suite of world-class APIs, eCommerce platform integrations, and easy to use applications for individual entrepreneurs, SMEs, and enterprises alike.

Our main focus is building the most advanced payment rails for Southeast Asia, with a clear goal in mind — to make payments across and within SEA simple, secure and easy for everyone. We serve thousands of businesses ranging from SMEs to multinational enterprises, and process millions of transactions monthly. We’ve been growing rapidly since our inception in 2015, onboarding hundreds of new customers every month, and backed by global top-10 VCs . We’re proud to be featured on among the fastest growing companies by Y-Combinator .

About the Job

We are looking for a Treasury Lead to help build and operate Xendit’s treasury function at scale.

You will work closely with the Head of Treasury and take meaningful ownership across liquidity, cash management, intercompany funding, banking infrastructure, FX, treasury controls, and financial risk.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will be expected to understand where our cash sits, where it needs to move, how it should be funded, what risks we are carrying, and where our treasury infrastructure needs to improve.

You will operate across multiple entities, currencies, banking partners and markets, often solving problems that do not have obvious or pre-existing answers.

We are looking for someone who combines strong treasury fundamentals with judgment, pace and a bias toward action.

Someone who can operate in detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.

What You’ll Own

Liquidity and Cash

- You will help ensure Xendit has the right amount of liquidity, in the right entity, in the right currency, at the right time.

- Own daily and medium-term visibility over Group cash and liquidity.

- Manage cash positioning and funding requirements across multiple entities and markets.

- Build and continuously improve cash forecasting.

- Identify trapped, idle or inefficiently deployed cash and develop solutions to optimize it.

- Help define appropriate liquidity buffers and escalation frameworks.

- Improve the quality, speed and reliability of treasury reporting.

The goal is simple: we should always know where our cash is, what we need, and what action we need to take next.

Intercompany Funding

As Xendit grows across markets, moving capital efficiently between entities becomes increasingly important.

- Manage intercompany loans, settlements, repayments and interest calculations.

- Coordinate funding requirements across Group entities.

- Maintain clear documentation and controls around intercompany balances.

- Work closely with Tax, Legal, Accounting and Finance to ensure funding structures are appropriate and properly executed.

- Help develop more scalable approaches to intercompany funding as the Group becomes larger and more complex.

- Identify friction, inefficiency or risk in the way capital moves across the organization and fix it.

We expect you to understand both the mechanics and the commercial implications of how capital flows through the Group.

Banking Infrastructure & Relationships

Our banking infrastructure is critical infrastructure.

You will work closely with Xendit’s Financial Partnerships team to ensure our banking relationships support both our treasury needs and the broader strategic needs of the business.

Treasury and Financial Partnerships will bring different but complementary perspectives: Treasury will focus on liquidity, funding, cash management, risk and operational requirements, while Financial Partnerships will help manage the broader strategic relationship with our banking and financial institution partners.

- Partner closely with Financial Partnerships on relationships with Xendit’s banks and financial institutions.

- Represent Treasury’s requirements and priorities in discussions with banking partners.

- Coordinate with Financial Partnerships on bank selection, account structures, liquidity solutions, credit facilities, FX capabilities and other treasury products.

- Own or support bank account openings, closures, mandates, signatories and user access.

- Improve how accounts are structured and used across the Group.

- Ensure appropriate controls exist around treasury payments and banking access.

- Resolve operational issues quickly when money needs to move.

- Evaluate opportunities to improve our banking stack, connectivity and automation.

- Ensure Treasury and Financial Partnerships maintain clear alignment on ownership, priorities and engagement with banking partners.

You should be comfortable working across functions and understand that managing a strategic banking relationship requires coordination, transparency and a unified Xendit approach.

FX and Financial Risk

Operating across multiple markets means operating across multiple currencies.

- Monitor Xendit’s FX exposures.

- Support execution of FX transactions and hedging strategies where appropriate.

- Identify material transactional and balance-sheet exposures.

- Help develop frameworks for managing currency risk.

- Monitor counterparty and concentration risks across banks and financial institutions.

- Support evaluation of deposits, credit facilities and other treasury products as Xendit’s needs evolve.

We are not looking for someone who simply reports risk. We want someone who understands it, communicates it clearly and helps us decide what to do about it.

Controls and Governance

Payments companies must move quickly without losing control.

- Maintain strong controls around liquidity, payments, banking access and treasury transactions.

- Help develop and improve treasury policies and operating procedures.

- Partner with Accounting, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Legal and Internal Audit.

- Ensure treasury activity is properly reconciled, documented and reflected in financial reporting.

- Identify weaknesses in existing processes and proactively improve them.

Good treasury operations should make the company faster and safer at the same time.

Build the Function

This role is not just about operating what already exists. You will help build what comes next.

- Automating treasury workflows.

- Improving cash forecasting models.

- Building treasury dashboards and management reporting.

- Standardizing processes across markets.

- Improving bank connectivity and payment workflows.

- Evaluating treasury management systems and tooling.

- Designing better ways to manage liquidity across entities and currencies.

- Developing new controls as the company scales.

How can we make this simpler, faster, more scalable and more reliable?

What We’re Looking For

We care more about capability than titles, but you will likely have around 6–9 years of relevant experience across corporate treasury, banking, payments, fintech or another complex multinational environment.

You should have:

- Strong hands-on experience with cash and liquidity management.

- Experience building or operating cash forecasting processes.

- Practical experience with intercompany loans and cross-entity funding.

- Experience managing multiple bank accounts, banks and currencies.

- A strong understanding of FX and treasury risk.

- Good knowledge of treasury controls and financial governance.

- Experience working across multiple legal entities or jurisdictions.

- Strong cross-functional skills and experience partnering with teams that manage broader banking or financial institution relationships.

- Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.

- The ability to independently diagnose and solve complex problems.

- The confidence to challenge existing processes when there is a better way.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex treasury issues simply.

Most importantly, you should be someone who takes ownership. When there is a problem, you do not wait for someone else to solve it.

You’ll Thrive Here If

You enjoy environments where:

- The business is growing quickly.

- Problems are not always neatly defined.

- The answer is not always written in a policy document.

- You are expected to think independently.

- You can move from strategy to execution in the same afternoon.

- People care about quality, but do not confuse process with progress.

- You are given meaningful responsibility and expected to deliver.

- You know how to work across teams without creating unnecessary silos.

You should be comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy and accountability.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:

- Payments, fintech or financial services.

- Southeast Asia or other multi-country environments.

- Regional treasury structures.

- Cash pooling or liquidity concentration.

- Cross-border funding.

- Treasury management systems.

- Bank APIs or treasury automation.

- Transfer pricing considerations relating to intercompany funding.

- High-growth or rapidly scaling technology companies.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, we should be able to say:

- We have better visibility over Group cash and liquidity.

- Our cash forecasting is materially stronger.

- Intercompany funding is faster, cleaner and better controlled.

- We understand our FX and liquidity risks more clearly.

- Our banking infrastructure is simpler and more scalable.

- Treasury and Financial Partnerships operate with clear alignment across our banking relationships.

- Treasury processes require less manual work.

- Management has better information for decision-making.

- We are better prepared for the next stage of Xendit’s growth.

This role is an opportunity to help build the financial infrastructure behind one of the most ambitious fintech companies in the region.

If you want to operate at the intersection of finance, technology, operations and scale, we would like to hear from you.
